pages.title: Midnight Monster Diner
pages.concept: An illustrated title cover introducing a mischievous all-night monster diner.
pages.artwork_description: A roadside diner counter is packed with a vampire, a one-eyed cyclops, a shaggy werewolf and a glamorous ghost, all facing an enormous haunted milkshake with a crooked straw, whipped-cream ghost and cherry eyeball. A crescent moon, diner sign and small stars frame the scene. Chunky arched title lettering reads “MIDNIGHT MONSTER DINER”; a small subtitle reads “COLOURING BOOK”.
pages.generation_prompt: Illustrated colouring-book cover: eccentric monster lineup at a retro all-night roadside diner counter, centred on an enormous haunted milkshake with ghost-shaped whipped cream, crooked straw and cherry eyeball; vampire, cyclops, werewolf and elegant ghost patrons; moon and diner sign framing the composition; exact title text “MIDNIGHT MONSTER DINER” in chunky retro lettering, small subtitle “COLOURING BOOK”.
pages.production_notes: Verify title spelling exactly. Keep the cover as uncoloured line art despite its illustrated-cover role. Ensure the milkshake is the clear focal point and all character silhouettes remain distinct.

pages.title: Graveyard Shift
pages.concept: A vampire waiter delivers a towering breakfast to a sleepy mummy customer.
pages.artwork_description: Inside the diner, a bow-tied vampire waiter balances a tray holding a stack of six pancakes, a skull-shaped butter pat and a steaming coffee pot. A bandaged mummy slumps in a booth beneath a window showing a moon and three tiny bats. The table holds a ketchup bottle, salt shaker and folded napkin.
pages.generation_prompt: Diner interior scene titled “GRAVEYARD SHIFT”: bow-tied vampire waiter carrying a tray with exactly six stacked pancakes, skull-shaped butter pat and coffee pot toward a sleepy mummy in a booth; moonlit window with three bats; ketchup, salt shaker and napkin on table.
pages.production_notes: Verify exactly six pancakes and three bats. Leave broad areas on the mummy wraps, booth, tray and pancakes.

pages.title: Jukebox Jitters
pages.concept: A living jukebox performs for dancing monster customers.
pages.artwork_description: A smiling retro jukebox with eyes, little arms and speaker-grille teeth plays music notes while Frankenstein-like dancer, ghost dancer and horned demon dancer twist nearby. A checkerboard floor uses large squares only; two simple wall records and a neon-style lightning bolt decorate the background.
pages.generation_prompt: Diner dance corner titled “JUKEBOX JITTERS”: anthropomorphic retro jukebox with eyes, arms and speaker-grille teeth playing music; three dancing monsters, a square-headed stitched monster, a floating ghost and a small horned demon; large checkerboard floor, two wall records and lightning-bolt decoration.
pages.production_notes: Keep checkerboard squares large and countable, not dense. Use only three dancers and exactly two wall records.

pages.title: Moon Pie Special
pages.concept: A witch cooks magical pies on the diner griddle.
pages.artwork_description: A witch in a curled hat flips three crescent-moon pies with a spatula behind the counter. A bubbling cauldron-shaped mixing bowl, flour tin, rolling pin and pie display sit nearby. Four small stars float above the griddle; the menu board has only decorative lines, no small wording.
pages.generation_prompt: Counter-kitchen scene titled “MOON PIE SPECIAL”: witch cook in curled hat flipping exactly three crescent-moon pies on a diner griddle; cauldron-shaped mixing bowl, flour tin, rolling pin and pie display; exactly four floating stars; menu board with blank decorative lines only.
pages.production_notes: Verify three pies and four stars. No legible small menu text beyond the page title.

pages.title: Booth for Two
pages.concept: A romantic skeleton couple share a banana split.
pages.artwork_description: Two stylish skeletons sit opposite one another in a high-backed diner booth, sharing one oversized banana split with three scoops, two spoons and a heart-shaped cherry. A small vase holds one wilted rose. The booth window shows a crescent moon and a single passing cloud.
pages.generation_prompt: Romantic diner booth scene titled “BOOTH FOR TWO”: two stylish skeletons sharing one oversized banana split with exactly three scoops, two spoons and a heart-shaped cherry; one wilted rose in a small vase; crescent moon and one cloud outside the booth window.
pages.production_notes: Verify the dessert has exactly three scoops and two spoons. Keep skeleton bones bold and separated into easy colour zones.

pages.title: Drive-Thru Doom
pages.concept: A nervous cyclops takes an order from a monster car.
pages.artwork_description: At the drive-thru window, a cyclops server in a paper cap hands a bag marked with a simple skull icon to a smiling coffin-shaped hot rod. Inside the car are a tiny green alien driver and a pet bat in the passenger seat. A large speaker box, order arrow and two puffs of exhaust complete the scene.
pages.generation_prompt: Drive-thru scene titled “DRIVE-THRU DOOM”: one-eyed server in paper cap passing a skull-icon takeaway bag through a window to a smiling coffin-shaped hot rod; tiny alien driver and pet bat passenger; large speaker box, directional arrow and exactly two exhaust puffs.
pages.production_notes: Verify two vehicle occupants and two exhaust puffs. The bag uses a skull symbol only, not text.

pages.title: Bottomless Brew
pages.concept: A cheerful swamp creature pours bottomless coffee.
pages.artwork_description: A friendly swamp creature with long arms pours coffee from a giant percolator into three mismatched mugs on a counter. The mugs show a moon, a bat and a skull symbol. A sugar dispenser, three doughnuts and a hanging lamp provide simple framing details.
pages.generation_prompt: Counter scene titled “BOTTOMLESS BREW”: cheerful swamp creature pouring from a giant retro percolator into exactly three mismatched mugs, decorated with a moon, bat and skull symbol; sugar dispenser, exactly three doughnuts and one hanging lamp.
pages.production_notes: Check exactly three mugs, three distinct mug symbols and three doughnuts. Preserve broad open shapes on the creature and percolator.

pages.title: Creature Feature Feast
pages.concept: A lagoon creature enjoys a dramatic seafood platter.
pages.artwork_description: A scaly lagoon monster in a diner bib sits before a platter containing a fish skeleton, two clam shells, lemon wedge and seaweed. A tiny octopus waiter carries a tray with a milkshake. Behind them, a porthole window reveals two fish and a crescent moon.
pages.generation_prompt: Diner table scene titled “CREATURE FEATURE FEAST”: scaly lagoon monster wearing a diner bib, seafood platter with one fish skeleton, exactly two clam shells, lemon wedge and seaweed; tiny octopus waiter holding a milkshake tray; porthole window with exactly two fish and crescent moon.
pages.production_notes: Verify seafood platter components and exactly two fish in the porthole. Ensure the octopus has eight clearly readable arms, without tangled overlap.

pages.title: Pie-Eyed Poltergeist
pages.concept: A ghostly pie contest causes comic chaos.
pages.artwork_description: A grinning floating ghost wears a diner bib and faces an enormous pie on a stand. Three pie slices hover around it, moved by ghostly swirls. A startled waiter drops one spoon, while a table tent displays a bold “1” for the contest table.
pages.generation_prompt: Comic pie-contest scene titled “PIE-EYED POLTERGEIST”: floating grinning ghost in diner bib confronting an enormous pie on a stand; exactly three pie slices levitating in swirls; startled waiter dropping one spoon; simple table tent with numeral “1”.
pages.production_notes: Verify exactly three floating slices, one spoon and one numeral 1. Avoid text other than the title and numeral.

pages.title: Monster Mash Hash
pages.concept: A cheerful kitchen crew makes a wild breakfast hash.
pages.artwork_description: A stitched square-headed cook stirs a giant skillet of hash marked with chunky potato cubes, while a two-headed helper cracks two eggs into the pan. A bat-shaped timer, spatula and striped tea towel sit nearby. The background has simple tiled wall shapes with ample white gaps.
pages.generation_prompt: Diner kitchen scene titled “MONSTER MASH HASH”: square-headed stitched cook stirring giant skillet of chunky breakfast hash; two-headed helper cracking exactly two eggs into the skillet; bat-shaped timer, spatula and striped tea towel; simple large tile wall.
pages.production_notes: Verify exactly two eggs and two heads. Keep the food shapes large rather than realistically detailed.

pages.title: Witch Way to the Restroom?
pages.concept: A witch asks a haunted sign for directions.
pages.artwork_description: A witch holding a handbag studies a comically confused freestanding signpost with a crescent-moon restroom symbol and three arrows pointing in silly directions. A shy black cat peeks from her hat brim. The diner corridor has a framed portrait of a smiling ghost and a potted carnivorous plant.
pages.generation_prompt: Diner corridor scene titled “WITCH WAY TO THE RESTROOM?”: witch with handbag looking at a humorous freestanding signpost bearing a crescent-moon restroom symbol and exactly three directional arrows; black cat peeking from hat; framed smiling ghost portrait and potted carnivorous plant.
pages.production_notes: Use the crescent symbol rather than extra restroom wording. Verify exactly three arrows; title punctuation must be correct.

pages.title: Shake, Rattle and Ghoul
pages.concept: Three ghouls enjoy monstrous milkshakes at the counter.
pages.artwork_description: Three distinct ghouls perched on diner stools sip from three extravagant milkshakes: one topped with a cherry eyeball, one with a tiny ghost biscuit, and one with a crescent cookie. A tipped sugar jar spills exactly seven large sugar cubes across the counter. A wall clock reads midnight with both hands pointing to twelve.
pages.generation_prompt: Counter scene titled “SHAKE, RATTLE AND GHOUL”: exactly three ghouls on stools drinking three extravagant milkshakes, topped respectively by a cherry eyeball, tiny ghost biscuit and crescent cookie; tipped sugar jar with exactly seven large sugar cubes; wall clock with both hands at twelve.
pages.production_notes: Verify three characters, three distinct toppings, seven cubes, and clock hands at 12:00. Keep cube shapes separated and large.

pages.title: Neon Night Shift
pages.concept: A giant neon diner sign comes alive after midnight.
pages.artwork_description: Outside the diner, an oversized retro roadside sign with a toothy moon mascot grins above the building. A small mechanic goblin stands on a ladder changing one light bulb, while a vampire customer holds a takeaway cup below. Four stylised stars and a crescent moon fill the open night sky.
pages.generation_prompt: Exterior roadside scene titled “NEON NIGHT SHIFT”: oversized retro diner sign topped with a toothy moon mascot; small goblin mechanic on ladder changing one bulb; vampire customer holding takeaway cup; diner facade, exactly four stylised stars and one crescent moon.
pages.production_notes: Keep the sign lettering decorative and limited to the page title only. Verify four stars, one bulb and a secure readable ladder.

pages.title: The Daily Scream
pages.concept: A werewolf reads the diner newspaper over breakfast.
pages.artwork_description: A fluffy werewolf in a booth reads an oversized newspaper with the short masthead “DAILY SCREAM”. On the table are a full moon waffle, a mug and a jam pot. Outside the window, a delivery van shaped like a hearse passes under three rain clouds.
pages.generation_prompt: Diner booth scene titled “THE DAILY SCREAM”: fluffy werewolf reading oversized newspaper with exact masthead text “DAILY SCREAM”; breakfast table with full-moon waffle, mug and jam pot; window showing a hearse-shaped delivery van and exactly three rain clouds.
pages.production_notes: Verify masthead spelling exactly and no other newspaper text. Confirm one waffle, one mug, one jam pot and three clouds.

pages.title: Coffin Break
pages.concept: A vampire takes a cosy break in a coffin-shaped booth.
pages.artwork_description: A suave vampire lounges in a vertically propped open coffin converted into a diner booth, holding a mug labelled only with a simple bat icon. A plate holds a donut with two fang-shaped bites. A coat rack, umbrella and small wall moon decorate the corner.
pages.generation_prompt: Cosy diner corner titled “COFFIN BREAK”: suave vampire relaxing in an open coffin converted into a booth, holding mug with bat icon; plate with one donut bearing exactly two fang-shaped bites; coat rack, umbrella and small wall moon.
pages.production_notes: Verify exactly two bites in the donut. Make the coffin booth clearly humorous and non-graphic.

pages.title: Pickle Panic
pages.concept: A mummy chef chases runaway monster pickles.
pages.artwork_description: A mummy chef runs after five lively pickle creatures rolling across the diner kitchen floor. Each pickle has simple eyes and tiny arms. A toppled pickle jar, burger bun, ladle and open swinging kitchen door create a clear action path.
pages.generation_prompt: Comic kitchen chase titled “PICKLE PANIC”: mummy chef chasing exactly five rolling pickle creatures with simple eyes and tiny arms; toppled pickle jar, burger bun, ladle and open swinging kitchen door; clear uncluttered action path.
pages.production_notes: Verify exactly five pickle creatures. Keep their shapes separated so each can be coloured independently.

pages.title: Table for Thirteen
pages.concept: Thirteen miniature monsters gather around one huge round table.
pages.artwork_description: A grand circular diner table is surrounded by exactly thirteen tiny, clearly separated monster diners: ghosts, eyeballs, bats, horned creatures and blob monsters. The table centre holds one cake with thirteen candles. A large chandelier and curtain frame the scene without crowding the diners.
pages.generation_prompt: Grand diner gathering titled “TABLE FOR THIRTEEN”: exactly thirteen tiny but clearly separated cartoon monster diners around one huge round table; centre cake with exactly thirteen candles; chandelier overhead and simple curtains framing the room.
pages.production_notes: Count carefully: exactly 13 diners and exactly 13 candles. Avoid overlap that makes monsters hard to count; use varied silhouettes.

pages.title: Sundae Under the Stars
pages.concept: A giant monster family enjoys dessert on the diner roof.
pages.artwork_description: On the flat diner roof, a tall friendly giant, a small cyclops and a floating ghost share a giant sundae bowl. The dessert has three scoops, one umbrella and two wafer sticks. The skyline is simple, with a crescent moon, four stars and the diner’s rooftop sign below.
pages.generation_prompt: Rooftop dessert scene titled “SUNDAE UNDER THE STARS”: friendly tall giant, small cyclops and floating ghost sharing giant sundae bowl with exactly three scoops, one umbrella and two wafer sticks; simple skyline, crescent moon, exactly four stars and rooftop diner sign.
pages.production_notes: Verify three characters, three scoops, one umbrella, two wafer sticks and four stars. Preserve wide open sky areas.

pages.title: Last Call for Creeps
pages.concept: The diner staff prepares to close at dawn.
pages.artwork_description: A sleepy zombie waiter flips a large door sign from an open circle to a closed crescent symbol while a witch sweeps and a vampire stacks three stools. Through the front window, the rising sun peeks behind two hills, but the scene stays playful rather than ominous. A single bat yawns from a ceiling beam.
pages.generation_prompt: Diner closing-time scene titled “LAST CALL FOR CREEPS”: sleepy zombie waiter flipping a large door sign from open circle symbol to closed crescent symbol; witch sweeping; vampire stacking exactly three stools; window with rising sun behind two hills; one yawning bat on ceiling beam.
pages.production_notes: Use symbols, not extra open/closed wording. Verify exactly three stools, two hills and one bat.

pages.title: Moonlight Takeaway
pages.concept: A monster delivery rider makes the final late-night delivery.
pages.artwork_description: A helmeted skeleton rides a retro delivery scooter with a sidecar shaped like a takeaway carton. The carton is packed with a pizza marked by eight large slices and a milkshake. The road curves past a diner sign, three tombstones and a full moon; two bats fly above.
pages.generation_prompt: Roadside delivery scene titled “MOONLIGHT TAKEAWAY”: helmeted skeleton riding retro delivery scooter with takeaway-carton sidecar; carton carrying pizza divided into exactly eight large slices and one milkshake; curved road, diner sign, exactly three tombstones, full moon and two bats.
pages.production_notes: Verify pizza is visibly divided into eight slices, plus exactly three tombstones and two bats. Keep delivery scooter outline robust and readable.

pages.title: See You at Midnight
pages.concept: A final celebratory diner tableau and friendly end page.
pages.artwork_description: The diner façade is seen front-on beneath a huge crescent moon, with the main monster cast waving from windows and doorway: vampire, mummy, witch, cyclops, werewolf and ghost. A large haunted milkshake sits on the roof like a sign topper. Six simple stars, two pumpkins and a blank banner provide a celebratory finale.
pages.generation_prompt: Finale colouring page titled “SEE YOU AT MIDNIGHT”: front-on retro diner facade beneath huge crescent moon; vampire, mummy, witch, cyclops, werewolf and ghost waving from windows and doorway; giant haunted milkshake roof topper; exactly six stars, two pumpkins and a blank celebratory banner.
pages.production_notes: Verify six named monster characters, six stars and two pumpkins. Keep banner blank for optional personalisation. Include the separate printing-and-colouring guide as an unillustrated supplementary PDF component, not a designed page in this 21-page artwork count; advise single-sided printing, fit-to-page disabled unless needed, and placing a spare sheet behind each page to prevent marker bleed.

selected_pages.reason: First illustration-led page (colouring): sets the core illustration style.
A different page type (colouring) tests a different layout and activity structure.
A later page (colouring, p21) checks the shared style stays consistent across the product.

images.prompt:
Original bold mid-century horror-cartoon colouring-book ink art for adults: clean white paper, thick varied black contours, rounded expressive shape language and crisp closed colourable forms. Medium-detail retro graphic styling with roomy open areas, selective simple patterning, controlled spot-black shadows and sparse screen-print-like texture marks. Playful, nostalgic and lightly macabre mood; no colour, gradients, hatching, grey wash, fine-line rendering or realistic shading. High-contrast, home-printable monochrome line work.

STYLE PARAMETERS: illustration style: Bold mid-century horror-cartoon colouring-book line art with a playful retro roadside sensibility.; line weight: Thick to very thick black outlines, with deliberate weight variation for emphasis; never fine line.; line quality: Smooth, confident, rounded ink contours with slightly bouncy hand-drawn energy; crisp closed shapes for easy colouring.; detail level: Medium detail: large, satisfying colourable shapes supported by selective decorative accents, simple patterns and readable background props; avoid dense micro-detail.; character language: Expressive, rounded cartoon anatomy with oversized features, theatrical silhouettes and mischievous adult-comedy expressions; recognisable through bold shape language rather than realism.; background density: Moderately populated scene dressing that frames the main action without filling every gap; preserve generous white areas and clear colour zones.; composition: Clear central focal hierarchy, bold foreground silhouettes and simple layered depth. Use open resting areas around focal forms, with secondary details arranged as readable framing rather than visual clutter.; palette: Pure black ink on clean white paper; artwork must remain entirely colourer-led, with no pre-coloured fills.; colour mode: black-and-white line art; shading: No realistic rendering, gradients or hatching. Use occasional solid black shadow masses, simple spot blacks and sparse graphic texture marks only where they strengthen contrast.; texture: Clean printable ink finish with restrained retro screen-print flavour suggested through sparse graphic marks, never dense noise.; mood: Cheeky, nostalgic, mischievous and lightly macabre; humorous spooky escapism for adults..

PAGE 2 of "Midnight Monster Diner Colouring Book" (colouring): Diner interior scene titled “GRAVEYARD SHIFT”: bow-tied vampire waiter carrying a tray with exactly six stacked pancakes, skull-shaped butter pat and coffee pot toward a sleepy mummy in a booth; moonlit window with three bats; ketchup, salt shaker and napkin on table.

CANVAS: A single portrait design with a plain white background. Keep a clear margin on every side; nothing important touches the edges, so it prints cleanly on a home printer. It is a colouring page: clean closed outlines on white, no grey fills or shading, easy to colour.
